notes: Elite FPS Boost: Nova Gaming power plan now unparks 100% of CPU cores, locks 100% minimum processor clocks, disables PCIe ASPM power saving, and disables disk spindown to eliminate 1% low FPS frame drops and micro-stutter
Ping Reducer Engine: Enabled AFD Fast Datagram Transmit (FastSendDatagramThreshold=1500) to bypass kernel buffer queues and deliver multiplayer UDP game packets directly to the NIC hardware interface
Network QoS Prioritization: Enabled DSCP/TOS priority headers (DisableUserTOSSetting=0) so gaming routers prioritize game packets over background household downloads and video streams
MMCSS Audio Low Latency: Set Audio task priority to High (GPU Priority 8, Priority 6) to eliminate DPC audio latency spikes and sound thread stutter
Multimedia Network Throttling Disabled & Foreground App Focus moved to 1-click safe optimizations
Pre-Game Boost expanded to politely suspend Windows 11 Widgets, Phone Link, and background telemetry before gaming
